purpose: Hand-authored (Claude, not Gemini) multi-label requirements for the 'ecommerce' domain, to teach the BERT classifier category semantics outside BFSI vocabulary. Every item is UNVERIFIED and needs a human label pass before it enters permanent training data.
instructions_for_reviewers: Confirm each 'categories' list against your project's 13-category definitions; add/remove labels.
Watch for over-labelling with 'Functional' -- keep it only where the system performs a concrete action.
'Regulatory' = a legal/standard mandate; 'Security' = protection mechanism. Don't conflate.
Single-label items are fine. Flip 'verified' to true only after a human check.

requirements.statement: The system shall allow a shopper to search the product catalogue by keyword, category, brand, and price range.
The system shall display real-time stock availability for each product on its detail page.
The system shall reserve inventory for items in a shopper's cart for fifteen minutes during checkout.
The system shall process a completed checkout and confirm the order to the shopper within three seconds.
The system shall support at least ten thousand concurrent shoppers during flash sales without page response times exceeding two seconds.
The storefront shall maintain 99.95 percent availability, measured monthly, excluding pre-announced maintenance.
The system shall degrade gracefully to a browse-and-cart-only mode when the payment service is unavailable, queuing orders for later processing.
The system shall integrate with multiple payment providers and route each transaction to the provider with the lowest cost for that payment method.
The system shall calculate order totals including item price, applicable taxes, shipping charges, and discounts.
The system shall let a merchandising manager schedule promotional pricing and banners to activate and expire at defined times.
The system shall store shopper passwords only as salted cryptographic hashes and never in a reversible form.
The system shall obtain consent before placing non-essential cookies or using shopper behaviour for personalised advertising.
The system shall let a shopper request export or deletion of their personal data and fulfil the request within the statutory period.
The system shall maintain an audit trail of all price and inventory changes, recording the user and the timestamp.
The system shall score each order on device, address, and velocity signals to detect fraudulent orders before fulfilment.
The system shall notify the shopper by email and push notification at order confirmation, dispatch, and delivery.
The system shall integrate with courier partners' APIs to generate shipping labels and retrieve tracking updates.
The system shall allow a customer support agent to view a shopper's order history and issue refunds or replacements within policy limits.
The system shall retain order and invoice records for the period required by tax law and make them available for audit.
The system shall provide the operations team a dashboard of order volume, fulfilment SLAs, and payment-failure rates updated every minute.
The system shall let a shopper check out as a guest without creating an account.
The system shall recover the storefront and order data to an alternate region within a recovery time objective of twenty minutes and a recovery point objective of one minute.
The system shall apply a coupon only if the order meets the coupon's eligibility rules and shall prevent a single-use coupon from being redeemed twice.
The system shall present the storefront in the shopper's preferred language and currency based on their profile or location.
The system shall alert the on-call team within five minutes if the checkout success rate falls below ninety-five percent over a ten-minute window.
The system shall reconcile payment gateway settlements against recorded orders daily and flag mismatches to finance.
The system shall rate-limit login attempts and require a CAPTCHA after five failed attempts from the same source.
The system shall let a marketplace seller upload products, manage stock, and view payouts through a seller portal.
The system shall encrypt shopper personal and payment data in transit and at rest.
The system shall archive orders older than three years to lower-cost storage while keeping them retrievable within twenty-four hours.
